sources.quote: At 42 days, discharge to home was 25% greater in the MFD than CONVENTIONAL dialysis group (17.5% versus 14%) without worsened hospitalization or death.
sources.searcher_note: Dialyze Direct-authored study (authors list Dialyze Direct affiliation); reports its on-site model shows no worsened death vs conventional dialysis. Company-affiliated; leans against the lead.

notes: No news, government or independent research source found naming Dialyze Direct, Dialysis Direct or Concerto with worse-than-expected survival ratings. Coverage found is company websites and Dialyze Direct-affiliated studies (Kidney360 2024, Hemodialysis International 2021), which report favorable or not-worse outcomes. Pattern coverage exists that nursing-home dialysis patients die at higher rates, but the most relevant paper (Kidney Medicine 2022, 'Nursing Home Status Adjustment for Standardized Mortality and Hospitalization in Dialysis Facility Reports') returned HTTP 403 on ScienceDirect and the journal site, so not recorded. PubMed returned a captcha; BMC Geriatrics 2026 paper redirected to a login. ASPE PTAC environmental scan on Dialyze Direct opened, no mortality finding.
